Done. Your bookmark manager is built and verified.

## What it does
- **Add / edit / delete** bookmarks — each has a URL (required), title (defaults to the URL), description, and comma-separated tags
- **Search** across title, URL, and description (live, as you type)
- **Filter by tag** in the sidebar, with per-tag counts
- **Persistent storage** in SQLite, so bookmarks survive restarts

## Stack
- **Backend:** Node + Express with a small REST API (`/api/bookmarks`, `/api/tags`) and `better-sqlite3` for storage
- **Frontend:** vanilla HTML/CSS/JS single page — no build step, HTML-escaped output to avoid injection
- Server listens on `0.0.0.0:4000` as the review environment expects

## Files
- `server.js` — API + static hosting
- `public/index.html`, `public/styles.css`, `public/app.js` — the UI
- `.harness/app.json` — registered so the client can launch it at `http://maker:4000`

I smoke-tested the API (create, list, tags, page load all returned correctly), then cleared the test data so you start with an empty list. The broker will start the app on the next review round.

Want me to add anything next — e.g. auto-fetching the page title from the URL, import/export, favorites, or duplicate-URL detection?
